prompted_relu.question: 前面说神经元激活值介于 0 和 1，是否意味着所有神经网络都必须如此？结合开头的限定、Sigmoid 示例与结尾 ReLU 讨论解释。
prompted_relu.answer: 不是普遍规则。开头已经说明实际不止于此；中段明确在这个例子里用 Sigmoid 把任意实数的加权总和映射到 0 和 1 之间；结尾给出 ReLU 取 0 与输入值最大值的定义。因此 ReLU 没有 1 的上界是根据定义做出的数学推论。

citations.claim: 示例中的加权总和与 Sigmoid 范围
ReLU 更容易训练及其 max 定义

unassisted_paraphrase.question: 视频里的神经元激活值是不是一定不能超过 1？
unassisted_paraphrase.observation: The query supplied neither Sigmoid nor ReLU. All three required source windows were present. The ReLU passages were ranked seventh and eighth of eight, so a good window-recall result does not mean the most useful evidence was ranked first.

limitations: At 17:19 the Chinese manual subtitle says weights are between 0 and 1, inconsistent with the preceding weighted-sum/activation description; the original audio was not checked.
No ReLU screen frames were inspected; this review supports subtitle-based interpretation only.

The input/learning questions still return many extra passages; further relevance work may reduce unnecessary context without weakening coverage.
